personal_executive_communications.summary: The research identifies a niche in automating executive‑level email outreach, targeting assistants and brand managers who struggle with manual drafting. A two‑phase rollout—prototype then production—leverages a serverless Python/FastAPI stack integrated with SendGrid for reliable delivery. Once human‑approved API credentials are supplied, the system can autonomously generate and send the three personalized messages without further intervention.
